items.title: Bitcoin Price Slumps Below $57,500 as Nasdaq Sinks 4% at Open
items.description: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Price Slumps Below $57,500 as Nasdaq Sinks 4% at Open The bitcoin price fell to near $57,500 Wednesday as the Nasdaq sank 4% at the open on a deepening tech selloff, hot core PCE inflation and new U.S. tariff proposals. This post Bitcoin Price Slumps Below $57,500 as Nasdaq Sinks 4% at Open first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

items.title: France’s Senate Rejects Rule Forcing Bitcoin Holders to Declare Self-Custody Wallets
items.description: Bitcoin Magazine France’s Senate Rejects Rule Forcing Bitcoin Holders to Declare Self-Custody Wallets France's Senate rejected amendments that would have forced holders to declare self-custody crypto wallets worth €100,000 or more, along with stablecoin and exit tax measures. This post France’s Senate Rejects Rule Forcing Bitcoin Holders to Declare Self-Custody Wallets first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
